components.name: cgm-coach-web
components.purpose: The browser screens where Delivery Managers, CLT members and action owners view account CGM, gaps, suggestions, plans, execution status and history, and record plans and action status.
components.rationale: application-types.yaml web-ui use_when: a key FR has a person viewing or changing data in a browser. Every key FR above has a signed-in user opening a view or saving a plan or status.

components.name: cgm-coach-api
components.purpose: The service that enforces sign-in and account entitlement, computes CGM, gaps, drivers, suggestions, comparisons and effectiveness from configured rules, reads source financial data read-only, and stores plans, decision records and status history.
components.rationale: application-types.yaml backend-api use_when: a key FR needs business rules, stored data or an API. FR-1.3 to FR-1.5 and FR-8.5 need entitlement enforced on API calls (AC-1); FR-1.1, FR-2, FR-6.4, FR-7.3, FR-8.3 need business-rule calculations (AC-5, AC-6); FR-4.5, FR-4.6, FR-6.2, FR-8.1 need stored, append-only records (AC-3); FR-5 needs a read-only boundary to source data (AC-2).
